instructions.question: What sentiment does this Czech Facebook comment express overall: positive (joy, praise, thanks, excitement), negative (complaint, sarcasm, disappointment, insult), or neutral (no clear feeling)?
instructions.rule: Annotators label the overall emotional tone of the comment, mostly not just whether the brand is named: thanks, wishes, cuteness, excitement and praise are positive even when the brand is not named. Complaints, sarcasm, insults to other users and sad or disappointed remarks are negative. Questions, tech-problem reports stated flatly, chit-chat, jokes without clear evaluation, and mixed or wry remarks ('stylish watch for a rubber-boot price :/') are neutral. Sarcastic praise ('Jupí, radujte se...') is negative.

neutral.what: Questions, information, plain reports of a problem, chat between users, jokes, and remarks with no clear positive or negative feeling.
examples: jak deaktivuji službu Útrata?? (how do I deactivate the Útrata service??)
Stylové hodinky, za cenu holínky :/ (Stylish watch, for a rubber-boot price :/)
ani mě to nejde nejsme jediní (it doesn't work for me either, we're not the only ones)
neutral.cues: otázky (questions) jak (how), kde (where), zajímalo by mě (I wonder); :D in banter
neutral.not_for: Problem reports with frustration ('Mě to právě nechce pustit... :-/', 'my stále čekáme :-/') are negative.

positive.what: Praise of products, ads or animals, thanks, congratulations, good wishes, eagerness to buy, try or visit, and loyalty statements.
examples: já mám o2 13 let a neměnila bych (I've had O2 for 13 years and wouldn't switch)
Děkuji, hezký večer (Thanks, nice evening)
Jaký je ňuňatýý! :)) (How cute it is!)
utíkám si je koupit (I'm running to buy them)
positive.cues: skvělé (great), úžasné (amazing), děkuji (thank you), těším se (looking forward), doporučuju (I recommend), nejlepší (best), krásná (beautiful), miluju (I love)
positive.not_for: Sarcastic praise such as 'Máte skvělou reklamu... v NAŠEM GANGU' is negative. Thanks after a routine action ('odesláno, děkuji') is neutral.

negative.what: Complaints about price, service, speed or taste, threats to leave, sarcasm, mockery, insults, and sad or disappointed remarks.
examples: Jdu si do trafiky pro simku konkurence, už mě to přestává bavit. (I'm going to get a competitor's SIM, I'm getting fed up.)
FUP 2 GB za 333,-Kč :-))))) už dlouho mě tak nikdo nepobavil (FUP 2 GB for 333 CZK, nobody has amused me this much in ages)
Je to smutný:-( (It's sad :-()
negative.cues: předražený (overpriced), drahý (expensive), nefunguje (doesn't work), odejdu (I'll leave), fuj (yuck), hnusné (disgusting), zklamal (disappointed), :( , :-/
negative.not_for: Neutral questions about faults with no emotion, and playful teasing between users, are neutral.
